### B. Detailed Breakdown (10-Point Inspection)
1. Frame & Composition + 2. Characters & Persons
• Eye-level three-quarter wide shot (16:9), shallow depth of field.
• 1 person fully visible: young woman (appears to be 20s) in midground,
charcoal waterproof trench coat, holding clear umbrella, calm focus.
4. Written Text (OCR) + 5. Colours & Hex Palette
• Upper-right brick wall sign: "OPEN 24H" in glowing amber/cyan neon.
• Palette: Deep Obsidian (#0D131F, 41%), Neon Cyan (#38BDF8, 18%),
Warm Amber (#F59E0B, 14%), Wet Slate Asphalt (#1E293B, 27%).
6. Lighting & Shadows + 8. Motion & Stillness
• Dual-source neon key light from upper-right (~3200K amber + ~6500K cyan).
• Falling rain streaks frozen mid-air; specular ripples in foreground puddles.
• Low-key nocturnal exposure (~34% mean frame luminance).
### C. Final Master Prompt (Paste-Ready Paragraph)
Cinematic nocturnal street photograph, eye-level three-quarter wide
angle (16:9), a young woman (appears to be in her 20s) with dark
shoulder-length hair wearing a matte charcoal waterproof trench coat
standing in the midground holding a transparent dome umbrella, gazing
toward a glowing neon sign on the upper-right brick wall reading
"OPEN 24H", wet cobblestone alley reflecting cyan (#38BDF8) and amber
(#F59E0B) light. Preserve original composition, colours, and text.
### D. Negative Prompt
extra people, extra fingers, distorted face, daylight, dry pavement,
misspelled neon text, missing umbrella, watermark, blurry foreground.
### E. Short Version (<75 words) & ### F. Uncertainty Notes
E. Short Version:
Photorealistic night street photo of a young woman in a charcoal trench coat
holding a clear umbrella in a rain-slicked alley under an "OPEN 24H" neon
sign, cyan and amber puddle reflections, moody low-key cinematic lighting.
F. Uncertainty Notes:
• Small secondary sticker text on the distant utility pole is blurred/unreadable.
• Footwear is cropped below the bottom edge of the frame.
Pass 7: Final Quality Check Verified
[x] Every person counted (including partial & background)
[x] Apparent gender presentation & age group stated as "appears to be"
[x] All visible written text ("OPEN 24H") transcribed & placed
[x] Exact HEX colours, lighting direction, and motion covered
[x] Nothing invented; unclear details isolated in Section F
